tech_stack.test: spring-boot-starter-test, reactor-test, embedded H2 for boot/slice tests only

build_order: domain: Telemetry Ingestion (sample, boundaries, revision, reorder window)
application: Telemetry Ingestion ports and use cases
infrastructure: Telemetry Ingestion append-only store and migrations
domain/application: Telemetry Stream Distribution (window buffer, broadcast port)
infrastructure/interface: Telemetry Stream Distribution consumer and downstream broadcast adapter

module_layout.integration: Ingestion publishes TelemetrySampleIngested, TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, TelemetrySampleBackfilled and TelemetryRevisionAppended through an application-layer event publisher port; Distribution consumes them in-process through a bounded, backpressure-aware reactive stream (Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(capacity, false), capacity from config); only events cross the boundary, never the store or reorder internals. The @SpringBootApplication class sits in the base package.

surfaces.name: IngestIngressPacket
operations: POST /api/v1/telemetry/ingress-packets: accept an Ingress Packet of 1Hz Telemetry Samples from a device
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: external -> Telemetry Ingestion (Conformist); invariants on validation, t_device reorder, append-only revisions

surfaces.name: TelemetryEventConsumer
operations: consume TelemetrySampleIngested, TelemetrySampleValidationFailed, TelemetrySampleBackfilled, TelemetryRevisionAppended from Telemetry Ingestion
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Telemetry Ingestion -> Telemetry Stream Distribution (Customer-supplier)

surfaces.name: SubscribeWindowedTelemetryStream
operations: GET /api/v1/telemetry/windowed-stream: downstream streaming analytics consumers subscribe to WindowedTelemetryBroadcast as a demand-driven server-sent event stream
surfaces.traced_from: context-map: Telemetry Stream Distribution -> external (Open host service / published language)

risks: Delivery posture and retry identity undefined (at-most-once vs at-least-once): dedup identity (device, metric, t_device) vs correction revisions is an open owner decision; plan must not silently dedup.
Bounds missing for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke and swim pace upper bound: boundaries bound to config keys, unbounded metrics not validated, no invented ranges.
Behaviour for packets later than the 60-second reorder window unspecified: default to appending an Event Revision (never drop), flagged as open.
Distribution invariant (only validated samples) conflicts with consuming TelemetrySampleValidationFailed: filtering rule needs owner decision; default is to not propagate failed samples as validated.
Reorder window buffers and sliding windows must be bounded (capacity from config); unbounded buffers prohibited.
Sinks must use autoCancel=false and bounded emit retry, otherwise one disconnect kills ingestion.
No blocking I/O on event-loop threads under burst; correlation id lost across reactive hops unless context-propagation is used.
Context split into two contexts is a low-confidence assumption; both live in one deployable so a merge stays cheap.

drivers: relational store accessed non-blockingly; embedded in-process substitute for boot and slice tests only
persistence.storage_paradigm: Append-only relational event log of telemetry samples and their revisions; owned only by Telemetry Ingestion. Telemetry Stream Distribution holds in-memory derived window buffers and persists nothing.
data_model: telemetry_sample_event: append-only raw sample (device identity, metric kind, value, t_device, t_ingress, validation status VALID|VALIDATION_FAILED, revision number, revision kind ORIGINAL|CORRECTION|BACKFILL, payload retained verbatim)
telemetry_revision: appended record referencing the original event for a correction or backfilled frame; originals never updated or deleted
audit_trail: append-only audit entries (actor, action, outcome, timestamp, correlationId)
queries: append a sample event or revision
read events of a device and metric ordered by t_device (never t_ingress) within a time range
read latest revision per (device, metric, t_device)
read events within the 60-second backfill window for reorder
persistence.migration_plan: Flyway expand-only versioned scripts V<n>__snake_case.sql under src/main/resources/db/migration, portable types (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE); index on (device, metric, t_device); no updates or deletes on event tables; distinct JDBC and R2DBC URL placeholders.
persistence.backup_recovery: Periodic snapshots plus point-in-time recovery of the append-only log; replay of the event history rebuilds derived window buffers.
open_questions: Retry identity versus correction revision for duplicate (device, metric, t_device)
Handling of packets later than 60 seconds
Bounds for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke, swim pace upper bound

observability.correlation_key: correlationId, generated or adopted per request by one interface-layer WebFilter, carried in the Reactor Context and written explicitly into every audit record; log lines do not rely on MDC

audit_trail.sink: append-only audit_trail store written through an application-layer audit port

observability.metric_tag_rule: bounded tags only (statuses, kinds, outcomes); never deviceId or other entity ids

export.logs: machine-readable structured JSON lines in Elastic Common Schema written to a local append-only rolling file sink (logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log); external log tooling such as Elasticsearch ships the file, the app never talks to it
export.audit: audit_trail table plus audit events in the same structured log file with the same schema
export.metrics: Micrometer meters exposed through the actuator metrics endpoint for external scraping; no push
export.offline_rule: no hard runtime dependency on any external tool; the boot test passes with all of them absent
